title: Text For UA V1.5
description: Text that a dialogue AIM addresses to the User Agent rather than to the User: an action the User asked for that only the User Agent performs - for instance, in Audio Scene Management, undo, save or stop - in the vocabulary of the App. The User Agent acts on it; the User hears what was done in the AIM's reply.

Text.description: The action, in the vocabulary of the App: for Audio Scene Management, "undo", "save" or "stop".
